clean.text: Hi Hanna, today I went to school with Jeff and Anna.
Anna, do you have any healing potions left?
Marcus, this blade is dull already.
Elara, my shoulder still aches from yesterday.
Jeff, how far is it to the city?
Good evening, Hanna.
Thank you, Marcus. I'll be back next week.
Jeff, Jeff, Jeff. What are we going to do with you?
Hey, Jeff, Anna, please come over here.
Hanna, watch the door. Jeff, with me.
Morning Hanna, morning Jeff.
Marcus and Elara, I need you both at the gate now.
Hanna, two ales. Anna, I'll take the red cloak. Jeff... nothing for you.
Good boy, Biscuit. Jeff, he's adorable.
Elara, Jeff, stand back, he's about to quench it.
Anna, Hanna, which of you sells rope?
Marcus, Elara, Jeff, thank you all for coming.
Hanna, have you seen Jeff today?
Hanna, tell Anna her order is ready.
Jeff is the laziest guard I've ever seen.
Anna's shop is closed again?
Elara, is Marcus around? His forge was cold.
Marcus, Jeff said you owe him money.
Oh sure, Jeff will save us all.
Psst, Anna. Don't look now, but Jeff is staring at you.
Elara, Marcus is hurt, come quickly!
Jeff! Hanna's inn is on fire!
Hanna, Jeff and Anna both told me you make the best stew.
Marcus, does Elara still live by the river?
Hanna! Over here! Bring Jeff if you see him.
Come on, Jeff, keep up. Biscuit's faster than you.
That's robbery. Anna charges half that.
Jeff, Anna said 'Marcus, come here' but he ignored her.
Anna, yesterday Hanna shouted 'Jeff, get out of my inn' at the top of her lungs.
Marcus, the note just says 'Elara, meet me at midnight.' Do you know who wrote it?
Everyone, listen up!
Alright you lot, back to work.
Goodnight everyone.
Hello, all! Lovely day.
Could all of you please step back from the well?
Nobody move. Hanna, blow out the candles.
Whoever owns this cart, move it!
Innkeeper, a room for the night, please.
Guard! Someone stole my purse!
Hey blacksmith, can you sharpen this?
Healer, my arm won't stop bleeding.
Guards, arrest that man!
You with the hammer, how much for a sword?
Barkeep, another round for the table.
Merchant, do you buy old armor?
Hey! Yes, you, in the apron. Two loaves please.
Hmm, where did I put that key?
Okay, okay, think. The map said north of the forge.
hang on, my mic is cutting out
brb, dinner's ready
Ugh, this quest is impossible.
Mom, I'll be home late!
Note to self: buy more arrows.
And what about you? Did you ever leave the village?
No, I meant the other one.
Thanks. See you tomorrow.
Fine. Lead the way.
Really? Then why is it already rusting?
You there, come here.
Excuse me, do you know where the healer is?
Are you the one who fixed my leg last spring?
Who's a good boy? You are!
I think, Anna, that your prices are too high.
Honestly, Marcus, I expected better.
Could you, Elara, take a look at this rash?
Is Marcus here? Oh, there you are. Marcus, I need horseshoes.
Jeff, if you touch my bag again I'll break your fingers.
Get out of my way, Marcus, or I'll move you myself.
Anna, you're a thief and everyone knows it.
Biscuit! Here, boy!
Jeff, does your dog bite?
Everyone except Jeff, come with me.
I'm not talking to you, Jeff. Hanna, another round.
Elara... no wait, Anna, you're the merchant, right?
